caption:
Three kinds of goodbye

I used to slip out of every visit without a word. Then I started turning around at the door.

How a visit ends tends to color how it is remembered, so the last few seconds do a lot of the work.

For whoever turns around at the door to say goodbye.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. An entryway with a door on the right and a royal blue figure on the left. Three short scenes, each labeled. The vanish: a teal figure walks out of the door without a word. The shout: a brown figure shouts bye! only after its back is turned. The turn: an ink-black figure walks to the door, turns around with a pulse and says bye!, and the blue one answers with happy eyes. The text stays: three kinds of goodbye. The last card: Choose friction.
comentario_fijado: A small friction, chosen on purpose.
